subject: Re: Redwood demo + procurement next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Aditi Mehra <aditi.mehra@sunnysidecloud.com>, Ravi Patel <ravi.patel@sunnysidecloud.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 8 Jun 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood demo + procurement next steps

Hi Aditi / Ravi - great speaking with you earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our end: 

Summary of call:
- Sunnyside Cloud is evaluating Redwood for low-latency inference across hosted + dedicated options for conversational customer support.
- Primary blockers identified: procurement path (PO vs card), security review, and legal MSA redline cadence.

Action items / asks (please confirm):
1) Procurement path: are you planning to pay by PO or corporate card? If PO, do you have an internal PO template we should review?
2) Marketplace interest: would you prefer a marketplace purchase (AWS Marketplace) or direct contract? Any preference affects billing flow and timing.
3) Security/legal owners: please confirm stakeholder names and expected review windows for Legal, Security, and Finance.
4) MPA: attaching a draft Mutual Action Plan (Redwood_MPA_v1.pdf) - would love preliminary feedback / redlines.

Proposed timeline (high level):
- Legal review: 2-3 weeks after MSA/MPA submission
- Security review: runs in parallel (3-4 weeks, includes questionnaire + SOC2 evidence)
- Finance PO issuance: 1 week after legal sign-off

If that aligns, we can put together a lightweight MPA with milestones and a short weekly check-in until PO is issued.

Thanks - I'll loop Camila on the commercial terms and Dylan for technical security support.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Attachment: Redwood_MPA_v1.pdf (MPA draft)

From: Aditi Mehra <aditi.mehra@sunnysidecloud.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ravi Patel <ravi.patel@sunnysidecloud.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@sunnysidecloud.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Jun 2026 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood demo + procurement next steps

Hi Marissa - thanks for the recap and the MPA. High level confirmation and timeline from my side: 

Procurement path:
- We plan to use a PO (preferred). Please review our PO template if possible.
- We are open to marketplace if it simplifies procurement, but we typically prefer direct PO for vendor-managed SLAs.

Stakeholders and expected windows:
- Legal: Priya N. (lead) - expects to start detailed review the week of Jun 21 (2-3 weeks).
- Security: Ravi Patel (security lead) - will run third-party security checklist; questionnaire attached (Sunnyside_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx). Target 3 weeks in parallel.
- Finance: Amy Chen (finance) - will approve PO after legal sign-off; target issuance 1 week after legal completes.

Estimated milestones (tentative):
- Week of Jun 21: Legal kickoff
- Jun 21-Jul 9: Legal + Security parallel reviews
- Jul 10-17: Finance PO processing and issuance

Requests for Redwood:
1) Please provide SOC2 or equivalent evidence and answers to the attached questionnaire.
2) Can you confirm support for SSO (SAML) and KMS integration details?
3) If you can provide a sample MSA/PO-friendly commercial term sheet it will speed our internal review.

I've attached our security questionnaire. Will loop procurement and Priya once we have the MPA redline.

Thanks,
Aditi Mehra
Senior Program Manager, Cloud Integrations
Sunnyside Cloud

Attachment: Sunnyside_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Aditi Mehra <aditi.mehra@sunnysidecloud.com>, Ravi Patel <ravi.patel@sunnysidecloud.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 9 Jun 2026 11:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood demo + procurement next steps

Thanks Aditi - this is super helpful and aligns with what I expected. Quick responses inline: 

- SOC2 / evidence: here's a link to our SOC2 report and controls map: https://drive.redwood.com/reports/SOC2-2026.pdf. Dylan will follow up with any supplementary controls evidence you need.
- SSO / KMS: Redwood supports SAML SSO and can integrate with customer-managed KMS for key encryption. I've asked Dylan to include an implementation note in the questionnaire.
- MSA / PO-friendly term sheet: attaching a short commercial summary and the MPA you reviewed. Happy to accept reasonable PO language; if you send your PO template we'll validate it against our standard terms.

Proposed mutual action plan (short):
- Jun 9: Draft MPA shared (done)
- Jun 21: Legal kickoff (Sunnyside)
- Jun 21- Jul 9: Security & Legal reviews (parallel)
- Jul 10-17: Finance PO processing
- By Jul 17: Target PO issued / contract effective

Next steps from Redwood:
- Camila will prepare a PO-friendly commercial term sheet and a cleaned MPA with milestone checkboxes.
- Dylan will respond to the security questionnaire with SSO/KMS notes + SOC2 evidence references.

Can you confirm the names/emails for Priya and Amy so we can add them to the MPA? Also would you prefer weekly 30-min MPA check-ins or biweekly?

Best,
Marissa

Attachment: Redwood_Commercial_Summary_v1.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 9 Jun 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Sunnyside Cloud - prep PO terms & security response

Camila / Dylan - quick internal note (not for external):
- Camila: can you draft a PO-friendly commercial term sheet (limit to 1 page) and a redline-ready MPA based on the attached draft? Include both card and PO billing flows and an AWS Marketplace option.
- Dylan: please fill out the Sunnyside questionnaire with SSO/KMS notes and attach SOC2 extracts. Aim to have both ready by EOD Thu Jun 11 so I can send back before legal kickoff.
- I'll coordinate pricing discount guidance with finance if needed once we confirm contract length.

Thanks - Marissa
